DJ.derived_from: NGS-DOSE-1000G docs/DJ.md: 3,202 genomes of the 1000 Genomes 30x cohort (NYGC, NovaSeq 2x150, PCR-free) and 56 HPRC release-2 haplotypes of 28 of them. level_exclude: the segments of the unit that vary between people (cohort SD per 5-kb sub-block, and the breakpoints the segment calls found). polymorphic: intervals that a common deletion removes from some junction copies; `offset` is what that cohort's comb gave, within 0.02 of the median log ratio of the estimate to the assembly's copies over the 18 genomes whose assembly resolves the junction (analysis/dj/polymorphic_offsets.py there). A cohort of at least scale.min_samples genomes finds its own
